systemic_causes.method: Extract all source algebra-carrier counts and author-explained or expressly unexplained rank restrictions, not only named composite fields.
Preserve could CKM/PMNS conjecture separately from source proposes predicts proton decay; no empirical validation.
Separate each original unnumbered displayed intermediate complex E6 and eight-space decomposition, no imported later revisions.
Capture actual bare source constants and mass/cosmological relations without claiming renormalized observed values.
Enumerate every frozen table/numbered figure and mark exact unqualified cells, do not treat a prior visual scan or internal consistency as cold source completeness.

corrected_before_first_commit.why: L-SSC-024 cross-revision identity cannot be fully sourced by original L01; anchor only its 2007 tentative part. Fig1/Fig5 original cells remain unaudited, so mark both P rather than M.

already_represented_in_separate_source_p.reason: L-SSC-031 already preserves 16 source Table4 electroweak roles and source-explains B1plus/B1minus as unobserved nonstandard right-chiral bosons.
L-SSC-044 already distinguishes original §2.4.1 xPhi rank-one shared Phi proposal and its conditional rather than derived status.
L-SSC-040 and L-SSC-044 already preserve the 18-root sector and original shared xPhi factorization; absent in-record L036 details alone are not missing research.
